sources.title: SupraLabs/Supra2-Medium-Base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Supra2-Medium Base is a 25M-parameter decoder-only language model pretrained from scratch by SupraLabs on 20B tokens of English web text. It uses the Qwen3 architecture with a custom 16,384-token tokenizer.

sources.title: SupraLabs · Independent AI Lab
sources.snippet: SupraLabs is an independent research lab building open small language and multimodal models that run on consumer hardware.

sources.title: SupraLabs (SupraLabs) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SupraLabs is an independent AI research org developing efficient, open-weight small models to make high-performance AI accessible on standard hardware. Learn more at supra-labs.com.
